evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared strategy is 기술선도 (Technology Leadership), which should favor lower-TRL exploratory R&D and longer preemptive timelines; however, all three selected technologies are TRL 5-6 (near-market) and the portfolio is relatively small and commercialization-oriented, creating mixed signals about true technology leadership ambition.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies — electric drivetrain integrated control, steer-by-wire, and vehicle communication gateway — are firmly within the ADAS/Autonomous Driving/Chassis Control domain, demonstrating strong domain coherence and awareness of key differentiation areas in next-generation vehicle architecture.
evidence.market_timing: For 기술선도, completion should ideally precede the boom by 1-2 years; T03 completes 1 year after its boom (2028-Q1 vs 2027-Q1), T01 completes 1.5 years after (2029-Q1 vs 2027-Q3), and T05 completes 2 years after (2030-Q1 vs 2028-Q1), meaning all three miss the preemption window and trail the market rather than leading it.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies have high market opportunity scores (all 5.0) and are in active patent areas for ADAS/chassis, but the roadmap documentation does not provide explicit evidence of deliberate convergence-zone targeting based on patent trend analysis — the alignment appears plausible but not demonstrably intentional.
